steps.name: Netsuite - Create Return Authorization
steps.code: const returnAuthRec = record.transform({ fromType: 'salesorder', fromId: '${input.netsuiteGetQuerySearchA2MM[0]?.id}', toType: 'returnauthorization', isDynamic: true }); returnAuthRec.setValue({ fieldId: 'cseg_ptr_return_typ', value: '${input.mapOE3Y[0]?.returnType}' }); returnAuthRec.setValue({ fieldId: 'custbody_ptr_item_restock', value: '${input.shopifyGetRefunds4EEC[0]?.restock}' }); returnAuthRec.setValue({ fieldId: 'custbody_celigo_etail_order_id', value: '${input.iterate3A4G[0]?.id}' }); returnAuthRec.setValue({ fieldId: 'memo', value: '${input.iterate3A4G[0]?.name}' }); returnAuthRec.setValue({ fieldId: 'otherrefnum', value: '${input.netsuiteGetQuerySearchA2MM[0]?.fields?.otherrefnum}' }); if (${input.mapOE3Y[0]?.partialDiscount || 0} > 0) { returnAuthRec.setValue({ fieldId: 'discountitem', value: 3013 }); returnAuthRec.setValue({ fieldId: 'discountrate', value: '${input.mapOE3Y[0]?.partialDiscount}' }); } const matchedItems = ${JSON.stringify(input.mapQEZS[0]?.matched || [])}; let hasValidLine = false; const lineCount = returnAuthRec.getLineCount({ sublistId: 'item' }); for (let i = 0; i < lineCount; i++) { const itemId = returnAuthRec.getSublistValue({ sublistId: 'item', fieldId: 'item', line: i }); returnAuthRec.selectLine({ sublistId: 'item', line: i }); const match = matchedItems.find(m => Number(m.netsuiteId) === Number(itemId)); if (match && Number(match.shopifyQty) > 0) { returnAuthRec.setCurrentSublistValue({ sublistId: 'item', fieldId: 'quantity', value: Number(match.shopifyQty) }); hasValidLine = true; } else { returnAuthRec.setCurrentSublistValue({ sublistId: 'item', fieldId: 'quantity', value: 0 }); } returnAuthRec.commitLine({ sublistId: 'item' }); } if (!hasValidLine) { throw new Error('Nenhuma linha válida encontrada para retorno.'); } let giftCardUsed = Number('${input.mapOE3Y[0]?.giftCardAmount || 0}') * -1; let totalAmount = Number('${input.mapOE3Y[0]?.price}') + Number('${input.mapOE3Y[0]?.partialTax || 0}'); if (giftCardUsed !== 0) { giftCardUsed = giftCardUsed > totalAmount ? totalAmount : giftCardUsed; returnAuthRec.selectNewLine({ sublistId: 'item' }); returnAuthRec.setCurrentSublistValue({ sublistId: 'item', fieldId: 'item', value: 2911 }); returnAuthRec.setCurrentSublistValue({ sublistId: 'item', fieldId: 'quantity', value: 1 }); returnAuthRec.setCurrentSublistValue({ sublistId: 'item', fieldId: 'rate', value: -giftCardUsed }); returnAuthRec.commitLine({ sublistId: 'item' }); } const total = returnAuthRec.getValue({ fieldId: 'total' }); if (!total || total <= 0) { returnAuthRec.setValue({ fieldId: 'taxamountoverride', value: 0 }); returnAuthRec.setValue({ fieldId: 'shippingcost', value: 0 }); const taxCodeField = returnAuthRec.getField({ fieldId: 'taxcode' }); if (taxCodeField) { returnAuthRec.setValue({ fieldId: 'taxcode', value: 'NON' }); } } const returnAuthId = returnAuthRec.save(); (returnAuthRec)
